dedupe_keys.name: the african development corridors database a new tool to assess the impacts of infrastructure investments

description: The African Development Corridors Database: a new tool to assess the impacts of infrastructure investments is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jessica P. R. Thorn et al. The large-scale expansion of built infrastructure is profoundly reshaping the geographies of Africa, generating lock-in patterns of development for future generations. Understanding the impact of these massive investments can inform development decisions related to the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals and African Union’s Agenda 2063 aims. Coverage: continental; published in 2022. Formats: CSV, Excel, GeoPackage, Image. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 109664307 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
